children: Addus HomeCare reported revenue of $387.73 million and net income of $28.59 million for the quarter, up 7% and 25.1%, respectively, from the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was $1.54, compared with $1.24.
¹ Reported as “Net service revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per share”.
Nine-month revenue increased 7.6% to $1.13 billion, led by personal care growth and higher hospice revenue.
Personal care revenue grew 9.3% over nine months, with billable hours up 4.9% and revenue per hour up 4.2%.
Hospice revenue rose 3.4% over nine months as census grew, while home health revenue declined 3.8%, mainly due to fewer visits.
Addus acquired HomeCourt in Indiana in May and agreed to acquire AccentCare’s non-New York personal care operations for approximately $275 million, subject to approvals.
The company operated 263 offices across 24 states. Caregiver shortages and inflation continued to challenge staffing and capacity.
